notes.title: Quality of life update
notes.notes:
Sorry for the lack of updates for Loot Goblins. 

In this update changes where made to the UI for when you are using a controller or mouse and keyboard. It has streamlined the experience. The other change is to Fart Bomb. One item has been added to give the power of the Fart Bomb. The ui has been updated to reflect the new changes

notes.title: 0.1.5 update
